query:
SELECT id,
                organization_id,
                COALESCE(email, '') AS "email!",
                invited_role::text AS "invited_role!",
                invitation_type::text AS "invitation_type!",
                target_user_id
         FROM organization_invitations
         WHERE status = 'PENDING'
           AND expires_at > now()
           AND lower(email) = lower($1)
         ORDER BY created_at DESC
